title: PageMeta
description: Cursor pagination metadata for list endpoints (includes limit, cursors, and optional exact totals).

limit.description: Max items per page (echo of the request).

next.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null if none.

prev.description: Opaque cursor for the previous page, or null if none.

exactTotal.description: Exact number of items in the full result set when known; omit when counting is too expensive.
